payload.summary: WATCH: suspected CrCl/QTc NumberField corruption (not reproduced on 2026-09-13 retest)
payload.detail: Earlier live desktop pass on psychiatry.tools prescribing mode: CrCl typed as 95 briefly displayed 42095; QTc showed unexpected 420. Suspected race in clinical-dashboard patient-profile NumberField (type=number + render sync) with writePatientProfile on every keystroke. 2026-09-13 re-verification could NOT reproduce (CrCl 95 and QTc 450 displayed correctly under slow type, replace, backspace). SaMD memo discusses broader patient-profile classification but does not evidence this corruption. Keep OPEN as a low-priority watch until Playwright digit-by-digit asserts values never gain foreign prefixes — do NOT treat as confirmed P1 clinical defect without reproduction. Stop: do not close from a single non-repro session alone; do not divert urgent clinical-safety work on suspicion alone.
payload.source: session 2026-09-13 live QA; Codex review: require evidence before P1
